comment: Very kind and caring professor. Lecture-heavy, but she walks you through everything very thoroughly. Engaging and easy even for students who aren't interested in accounting. Do the HW! Don't chat it! Then the tests will be quite easy.

Professor Sadler has a remarkable ability to make the dense complexities of tax law engaging. Her teaching style is highly structured; the handouts provided are helpful, and the practice questions are similar to the exam for preparation. Her patience and accessibility outside of class make her one of my favorite profs in B-school.

She will hold your hand through the class but she'll consistently switch up on exams, adding nuance to questions that you wont find in the lectures, practice problems, or exam review. Tax is not a class where you can write-off nuance as "something you've never seen before so it must be the wrong answer". UR should invest in another tax prof.

Professor Sadler is a great professor. Financial Accounting isn't my best subject, but she teaches great. If you aren't the best test taker, TAKE THIS CLASS. While there's a lot of homework, it's not too hard if you put in the effort. She gives a lot of weight toward homework. Missed a lot of class for sports, but she always helped me catch up.

Dr. Sadler is my favorite professor I've had at UR so far. She not only cares how you perform in the classroom, but also your well-being outside the classroom. Her lectures are very straight foward and she is willing to clarify if confused. If you pay attention in class and actually do the homework the class is a breeze.

A very passionate, honest, and caring professor. Her lectures were well structured and helped condense the information from the textbook to make it learnable. Homework was not excessive and relevant. Tests were manageable and made for you to succeed if you studied and were attentive in class. Grading was balanced between tests and assignments.

Dr. Sadler is a great professor who puts a lot of time into her students and has a great teaching structure. She always makes the lectures engaging and fun, telling stories and using jokes to help students understand the topics. I would definitely recommend Dr. Sadler to anyone who can take her classes.
Dr Sadler cares great amounts about her students and accounting. Her handouts and lectures are clear and easy to refer back to. Class is manageable if you follow along and study. Take her class!!

She is very nice, but the class is pretty tricky if you don't dedicate the time. It's easy to miss stuff since the packets are mostly filled out ahead of time, and there are no cheat sheets for exams. She is very open for the tax return projects though which makes it easy to get high grades on those.

I would never take another class from Abbie Sadler. I was miserable and bored in class. She gives you handouts like you're seven years old, where you just fill in the blanks (making it hard to pay attention). The tests came out of left field, and I felt like she didn't really care if we did well or not.
She's very sweet and I really enjoyed being in her class. She tried her best to explain concepts to me.
She was one of the nicest professors I've had here. As long as you pay attention in class and make sure you understand the homework you will be fine.
She is so sweet and helpful! She quickly responds to emails and wants to see you do well!

Dr. Sadler is an amazing professor to take if you'd actually like to learn the basics of accounting. She isn't the easiest professor, so paying attention during lectures and staying on top of assignments are the keys to success. Limited extra credit, so good performance on exams is necessary for a good grade.

I LOVE DR.SADLER! As a non-business major accounting seemed like a very daunting class. However, Dr.Sadler is incredibly supportive and truly wants all her students to succeed. Highly recommend anyone taking this course to take it with Dr.Sadler.

honestly cannot say enough good things about dr. sadler. awesome professor & an even better person. going to your tax return meeting with the forms already filled out is a must! she's more than willing to answer q's, but you definitely need to put in the work & show that you're trying. conveys material so clearly. would rate above 5 if i could :)

easily one of my favorite profs of all time! she takes tax & turns it into material you want to learn which isn't easy. she's HILARIOUS & i love her. book isn't well-written, but her handouts are easy to understand. be ready for the second test! i recommend doing practice problems in the book for extra help to really nail it & she'll send u answers

Great teacher and is very practical. Homework, tests, and quizzes are completed online so you need to buy the textbook and program to complete assignments. Topics were reviewed in class, but a good amount of self-teaching. Always available outside of class and genuinely wants to help her students. Exams were slightly hard but offered partial credit

I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Sadler. She is a young professor who is excited to teach accounting, and she does it fantastically. Every class we work on relevant problems and the homework is very helpful, too. You really don't have to do any reading for this course as she walks you through everything you need to know in class.

Does what she can to make a class like tax interesting. She does a good job breaking down the horribly written textbook into easily digestible handouts, and projects help you nail down material. Very very helpful in office hours.

Dr. Sadler is a super young professor who really cares about her students. It wasn't an easy class, but it wasn't hard either because she gives worksheets that outline everything you need to know. If you have ANY questions go to her office hours because she really wants to help you. Study the worksheets and the problems from class for the tests.
